sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Make Amends - Equipment is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. Listen, mercenary, I've made arrangements with Lightkeeper for a test delivery of the supplies he needs from the list. I think I might be able to get close to him. That's what I wanted to talk to you about. There's a rumor going around that you two have trust issues. So let's help each other. You find me the supplies I need, and I'll handle the transportation. I'll put in a good word for you. Okay, he needs... Whoa. He needs sniper rifles, and lots of them."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over the 4 found in raid SVDS sniper rifles

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
"Are the weapons ready? Great, thanks for your help!"
